sources.document_title: High Diode SMAJ series transient voltage suppressors
sources.locator: Page 1 features/polarity and page 2 exact SMAJ20A electrical row; pages 5-6 waveform/package
sources.evidence_extract: Official PDF states PPPM 400 W for a 10/1000 us pulse, -55 to 150 C, band marks cathode, and exact SMAJ20A: VBR 22.2-24.5 V at 1 mA, IR at most 5 uA at 20 V, VRWM 20 V, IPP 12.3 A, VC at most 32.4 V at IPP and TA 25 C. The API PD_mW field is not used for the 400 W claim.
